blocks.alt: Mangrove ka manzar. Avicennia marina ke darakht, gol surmayi-sabz chhatriyon ke saath, paani ki nahar ke kinare keechar (mudflat) par; keechar se pencil jaisi bohat si saans lene wali jarhein (breathing roots) upar nikli hain. Labels: darakhton mein bagle (herons) aur egrets, paani par battakhein, paani ke neeche jheenge aur keechar par kekre.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.14: Mangrove jangal aur us ke numainda paude aur janwar (kitab ki tasveer, Figure 25.14, ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer mein darakht mehraab jaisi tangon (stilt roots) par khare hain, jo Rhizophora jaise mangroves ki pehchaan hai. Lekin kitab ke mutabiq yahan ka 95% jangal Avicennia marina (timmar) hai, jis ki 'breathing roots' keechar se pencil ki tarah seedhi upar nikalti hain (pneumatophores). Is liye khaake mein yehi jarhein dikhai gayi hain; in se jarhein oxygen-kam keechar mein saans leti hain.
